title: Rootline walkthrough: the future, clearly labeled moonshots
description: A clickable walkthrough of Rootline's later bets, each labeled V1, V2 or V3: a living property record, a Landscape Passport that transfers at home sale, AR in the yard, robotic mower fleets, closed-loop irrigation with soil sensors, plant health AI, predictive pricing, partner-funded working capital, sustainability reports, Autopilot, a Spanish voice assistant for crews and an MCP server for the owner's own AI.
